grade.went_well: The answer finds the right include line and describes both fixes accurately, including the cm_startyear condition. It lists the three RIKEN scenarios with their internalization settings and quotes the realization's limitation comment. It also flags honestly that it found no code in 51 that unfixes the variable.
grade.answer_key_issues: None substantive. The key calls the column 'internalize'. The actual switch/column name is internalizeDamages (main.gms:453, RIKEN csv header).
grade.summary: The core answer is correct: the switch condition, what bounds.gms fixes, and the three RIKEN scenarios are right. The main error is naming the internalization switch 'cfg$gms$damages_internalize' when the real name is internalizeDamages. It also implies the fix is bypassed under KotzWenzItr, when that realization actually adds an SCC tax on top. Separately, it says only one config file mentions KotzWenz, but default.cfg:148 also references it.
